title: PAR-134 VIEW/VPORT ambient CMC metadata and class-specific DXF projection
mode: generated AC1024/AC1032 DWG and ASCII/Binary DXF fast slice
scope: Retain R2007+ ambient CMC method, flags, reserved BS index, and separate optional names/books for VIEW and VPORT table records
Replay source CMC metadata or refuse unsupported/mismatched DWG representations before output
Apply documented class-specific DXF mappings and refuse unrepresentable legacy/richer VIEW states

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: R2007+ VIEW and VPORT ambient fields use CMC; ODA maps VIEW ambient color to group 63 and documents VPORT groups 63, 421, and 431. R2004+ CMC has a zero reserved BS index, a packed method/color BL, and optional-name flags/strings.

autodeskDxfReferences.finding: Autodesk's VPORT DXF table explicitly lists ambient groups 63, 421, and 431; its numerical group-code table classifies 430-437 as strings used for named truecolors, so VPORT keeps 431 as one color-name string (including the existing BOOK$ENTRY spelling) without inventing a separate 430 field. Its current VIEW table does not list ambient-color groups; accordingly, VIEW serialization is limited to ODA's scalar group 63 and refuses RGB/name/book state rather than emitting undocumented 421/431 fields.

localSource.finding: VIEW/VPORT bounded CMC reads previously requested RGB/name/book but omitted raw method/flags/index, and DWG writers canonicalized to indexed or RGB forms while dropping other metadata. Writers now preflight metadata before bytes, preserve supported C0-C3 with optional strings, and charge retained strings in adapter accounting. DXF group parsing clears DWG-only provenance.

productionSummary: Retain and expose ambient CMC source metadata for both VIEW and VPORT; compose BOOK$ENTRY names using the raw book-present flag, including empty-book cases.

DWG encoders replay supported C0-C3 methods, name/book flags, and separate strings; reject unknown flags, nonzero reserved indices, method/value mismatch, unsupported methods, and non-default pre-R2007 ambient state before output.
DXF VPORT keeps its documented 63/421/431 projection. DXF VIEW emits only scalar group 63 and atomically rejects RGB/name/book state; legacy output rejects non-default ambient values.
Adapter memory estimates include the retained CMC name and book strings for VIEW/VPORT.
changes.publicApiOrLayoutNote: VIEW/VPORT object sizes grow by retained private CMC metadata; a non-virtual read-only accessor was added. Downstream consumers must rebuild.

generatedControls.fullDwgRoundtrip: AC1024 and AC1032 generated DWG routes cover VPORT named RGB and VIEW book-only ACI, plus an empty-book VIEW name; checks include method/flags/index, copy/reset, rewrite, and reread.
generatedControls.dxfProjection: ASCII and Binary DXF controls inspect literal VPORT groups 63/421/431 and scalar-only VIEW group 63, then parse back and verify DXF import clears DWG provenance.
generatedControls.failClosed: Direct DWG encoders reject unknown CMC flags, nonzero reserved index, C5 Foreground writer mapping, and non-default pre-R2007 fields without changing body/string/handle buffers. Atomic DXF controls reject legacy ambient data and rich VIEW RGB/name projections while preserving an existing destination.
generatedControls.emptyBook: Generated DWG checks preserve an explicitly-present but empty book name via flags and the public $ENTRY form; no persistent fixture was added.
